title: Fusion Gains Depend on the Implementation and the Calibration Target: An 18-Task Study of Prediction Intervals with a Single-Source Fallback
abstract: arXiv:2611.31333v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A fused model can benefit from an extra learning stage as well as from a second data source. We compare four fusion implementations with matched single-source learners on 18 regression tasks with prediction intervals. Across ten refits under group-wise calibration, linear stacking improved the interval score by 6.0% against a source model without a second stage and by 0.1% against its matched single source. The four implementations agreed on 3 of 18 tasks and gave opposite clear verdicts on 12, including 8 of the 10 tasks with naturally distinct sources. With pointwise calibration, they agreed on 5 tasks and gave opposite clear verdicts on 9. A development-set selector with a matched single-source fallback improved ten-refit task-averaged scores by 2.2--6.3% in every implementation under both calibrations. translated_title: 融合收益取决于实现方式与校准目标：一项关于带单源回退的预测区间的18任务研究
translated_abstract: 融合模型既能从额外的学习阶段中受益，也能从第二个数据源中受益。我们在18个带有预测区间的回归任务上，将四种融合实现方式与匹配的单源学习器进行比较。在分组校准下的十次重新拟合中，线性堆叠相较于没有第二阶段的源模型将区间分数提高了6.0%，而相较于其匹配的单源模型仅提高了0.1%。四种实现方式在18个任务中仅在3个任务上结论一致，并在12个任务上给出了截然相反的明确结论，其中包括10个具有天然差异来源任务中的8个。在逐点校准下，它们在5个任务上达成一致，并在9个任务上给出相反的明确结论。在两种校准方式下，带有匹配单源回退的开发集选择器在每种实现方式中都将十次重新拟合的任务平均分数提高了2.2%至6.3%。将融合模型加入单源候选池中，使平均相对分数提高了约5个百分点。在分组……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究通过对18个回归任务的实证比较发现，融合方法的收益高度依赖于具体实现方式与校准目标，而结合单源回退的开发集选择器能在所有实现和校准设置下稳定提升预测区间性能。
en_tdlr: This 18-task study shows that fusion gains depend heavily on the implementation and the calibration target, while a development-set selector with a single-source fallback robustly improves prediction interval performance across all implementations and calibrations.
